# Get Text From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets the text from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getTextFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getTextFrom(input: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
